categories.intro: Q. Why does Alaska want to help you start a business, become self-employed, or create an organization? A. Because of jobs. If you create a job for yourself or for others, you will pay more taxes, be satisfied in life, and re-elect the current politicians. That is why the state has so many programs to help you. The sources below are just the starting places and a few samples. The real work to take these sources and work with them is up to you. Ask questions about other sources. And then do the same with those sources. It’s not easy. You must take your time. It is like panning for gold or solving a crime on CSI. In the beginning of any research, it is best to say… “I Need Help to Start (or Grow) My…..” This way, you are open to learning about dozens of other ways to get money and help for your venture that are not grants.

Medicare is a federal health insurance program for people 65 and older and for people under 65 with specific disabilities. programs.title: Dental Coverage Under Medicaid
programs.text: Medicaid is a state-run program that provides medical benefits — and in some cases dental benefits — to eligible individuals and families. States are required to provide dental benefits for children covered by Medicaid, but states can choose whether to provide dental benefits for adults. Most states provide only limited dental services for adults, while some offer extensive services. Visit the Medicaid web site and click on "Learn How to Apply for Coverage" or contact your state Medicaid program.

programs.title: How to Legally Get Money from Your Congressperson
programs.text:
The office of your elected officials can be the best place to turn to get free help. They are in the best position to be aware of the free help and services that are available in your community as well as the state or national level. Your representatives also have the most power to help and have the biggest motive to help.
Their Power… The government bureaucracy that provides money and services to the community relies on elected officials for their money. You may pay the taxes but it is the elected officials who “control the purse strings” and determine the budgets and salaries for government bureaucrats. These government agencies have special backdoor phone numbers to handle requests from elected officials while you and I have to wait in line at the front door.
Their Motive... Elected officials WANT to help you because if they are able to make a phone call and get you the help you need, you will vote for this official no matter how many sex scandals they have.
Your search will show the elected officials below with hotlinks to their websites.

programs.title: 10 Ways to Reduce Your Mortgage Payments by $1,000 Per Month
programs.text:
There are a number of programs to assist homeowners who are at risk of foreclosure and otherwise struggling with their monthly mortgage payments. The majority of these programs are administered through the U.S. Treasury Department and HUD. This page provides a summary of these various programs. Please continue reading in order to determine which program can best assist you.
Please read FHA's brochure, " Save Your Home: Tips to Avoid Foreclosure," also published in Spanish, Chinese and Vietnamese.
Here is a description of the programs.
Modify or Refinance Your Loan for Lower Payments
1. Home Affordable Modification Program (HAMP): HAMP lowers your monthly mortgage payment to 31 percent of your verified monthly gross (pre-tax) income to make your payments more affordable. The typical HAMP modification results in a 40 percent drop in a monthly mortgage payment. Eighteen percent of HAMP homeowners reduce their payments by $1,000 or more.
Underwater Mortgages
In today's housing market, many homeowners have experienced a decrease in their home's value. Learn about these MHA programs to address this concern for homeowners
